raw_notes: This is one of the few helmets that can be worn by Knights which can be imbued with up to Tier 2 [[Intricate Epiphany|Epiphany]] (Magic Level boost) [[Imbuing|imbuements]]. It's also one of the few helmets available for Paladins with this property.
This helmet can be imbued with [[Basic Epiphany]] ([[Magic Level]] bonus), but not with [[Intricate Epiphany|Intricate]] or [[Powerful Epiphany]].
